spans.text: Every attempt is a crossing on `record/build-record.jsonl`, written by the server itself: a `build-run` row lands BEFORE the process starts (code by its sha256 and kept to a declared budget) — no record, no run; the one place in serve.mjs where a failed append stops the act instead of disclosing it after the fact — a `build-run-result` row lands as it resolves (exit code, timing, true output size beside what the cap kept), and a `build-run-refused` row lands for a rejected attempt (off-loopback, no runner for the language, a malformed body) — so refusal is as visible as success.
